description: This file defines the 'Coocook::Controller::Admin' package, which is a controller class for administrative functions in a web application. It includes methods for handling admin dashboard, listing organizations, projects, recipes, and users, and setting up navigation menus.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Admin
classes.description: Controller class for admin-related actions, extending Coocook::Controller, handling admin dashboard and resource listings.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Sets up the base path for admin routes and initializes the submenu items for the admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the admin dashboard, displaying recent organizations, projects, recipes, and users.

methods.name: projects
methods.description: Lists all projects with owner info and URLs.

methods.name: recipes
methods.description: Lists all recipes ordered by name.
